description: Publishes a selected-field snapshot of records whose source status is exactly Active in the official Connecticut Business Registry Business Master dataset, preserving source-specific status, ALEI and record identifiers, reported business addresses, classifications, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.ct.gov metadata and n7gp-d28j JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, duplicate identity, source refresh drift, count mismatch, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: The selected-field source snapshot is acquired in strictly increasing source-ID order and hashed before normalization. Source metadata and the active count are rechecked before publication. A complete unpublished staging run can be independently verified and resumed by immutable run ID without reacquisition. current.json changes only after complete run-scoped publication.
idempotency: The source rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release; the source system ID creates a stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Abort network requests and local record processing cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and approved public normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
